title: No information-processing level between neurons and consciousness

statements.text: Against the central doctrine of cognitive science, there is no level of real information processing between the neurophysiological level and consciousness. There are blind neurophysiological processes and there is consciousness, and nothing else.

sources.locator: p. 195, quoting The Rediscovery of the Mind, p. 228
sources.quote: There are brute, blind neurophysiological processes and there is consciousness, but there is nothing else
